name: NotificationCenter
purpose: A right-side notification panel with search, all/unread views, read state, and optional item actions.
description: A notification inbox that slides in from the right. Search and All/Unread views stay local; read, dismiss and open callbacks let the host persist changes. Async callbacks are guarded and failures stay visible without removing the original notification.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Runs after the panel finishes opening or closing, for coordinated navigation.

props.name: onReadChange
props.type: ((ids: string[], read: boolean) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined

guidance.overview: A right-side notification panel with search, all/unread views, read state, and optional item actions.
usage: The host owns items and persists onReadChange and onDismiss updates. The component does not mark items read merely because the inbox opens.
Opening an item calls onOpenItem and then marks it read when onReadChange is available. Mark all read applies to all unread items, not only search matches.
Return promises from callbacks so pending actions are guarded and failures remain visible.
accessibility: The trigger includes the unread count. The titled side panel traps focus while open, closes with Escape, and restores focus to its trigger. Tabs names the All and Unread views.
When an action removes the focused item from the view, focus returns to search; outcomes are announced in a status region.
context: Use as a persistent application inbox; use Notification for transient feedback about a single operation.
